advancements.mineralogy.all_the_rocks.de: Wow, you've found all the standard rock types in Mineralogy!
tooltip.mineralogy.geology_mode: Sky uses biome-influenced geomes. Cyano (Legacy) uses the original Cyano rock-layer engine.
tooltip.mineralogy.crude_oil: Generate covered crude oil deposits in sedimentary rock beneath oceans.
tooltip.mineralogy.horizontal_size: Controls how far individual rock formations persist horizontally.
tooltip.mineralogy.vertical_thickness: Controls the typical vertical thickness of rock layers.
tooltip.mineralogy.waviness: Controls the broad vertical slope and curvature of rock layers.
tooltip.mineralogy.edge_irregularity: Adds independent small-scale detail along layer boundaries.
tooltip.mineralogy.formation_continuity: Controls how often formations retain their identity across regional and geome boundaries.
